text: Dynamic elements built into the regulatory structure would allow regulators to continually adapt to new market environments, to financial innovation, and to changes in financial markets that are themselves caused by financial regulation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857
